lessons.title: From FC Germania to SV Elversberg
lessons.subtitle: The club’s early identity took shape through a wartime interruption and a new name.

story.title: A club begins
story.body: SV Elversberg’s own chronology dates its founding to 1907, when it was called FC Germania Elversberg.

story.title: A name returns
story.body: The club dissolved in 1914 during the First World War and was re-founded in 1918 as Sportvereinigung Elversberg VfB.

facts.label: Elversberg founding year
facts.prompt: In what year does SV Elversberg date its founding?
facts.scope: Club founding year, as given by SV Elversberg.
facts.evidence: The official club chronology says SV Elversberg was founded in 1907.

facts.label: Elversberg’s first name
facts.prompt: What name did Elversberg use when the club was founded in 1907?
facts.scope: Founding name, not a later legal name.
facts.evidence: The club history identifies FC Germania Elversberg as the name used at its 1907 founding.

facts.label: Elversberg’s 1918 re-founding name
facts.prompt: Under what name was the club re-founded in 1918?
facts.scope: Name at the 1918 re-founding.
facts.evidence: The club chronology says it was re-founded four years after its 1914 dissolution under the name Sportvereinigung Elversberg VfB.

story.body: Elversberg won the tie 5–4 on penalties, then reached the second round, where it lost 0–3 to 1. FC Nürnberg.

facts.scope: Method of deciding the first-round cup tie after regulation play.

facts.evidence: The club says promotion came with its 100th win in the 2. Bundesliga.

lessons.title: A contribution to the cup double

story.title: The cross that mattered
story.body: Early in the second half against Saarbrücken on 3 June 2023, Feil crossed from the right. Marcel Gaus handled the ball, and Elversberg received a penalty.

story.title: A trophy contribution
story.body: Nick Woltemade converted in the 50th minute. Elversberg went on to win 3–2 after extra time and lift the Saarland Cup alongside its league title.

facts.evidence: The official final report records the Saarland Cup win and Feil’s cross before the second-half penalty.
